theme_and_archetype.rationale: Legal websites demand authority, clarity, and trust. By combining the stark clarity of Swiss Brutalism (White/Black) with the premium depth of Jewel & Luxury (Matte Gold accents, architectural photography), we create an 'Old Money Tech' aesthetic that feels elite and intellectual.

rules: NO default Tailwind yellow or amber. Only use the defined matte gold (#C5A059).
NEVER use pure black #000000; stick to #111111 for depth without harshness.
Hover states for gold must darken to #A88544.
Containers must not use flat grey boxes. Use 1px borders (#EAEAEA) on #FDFDFD backgrounds instead.

hierarchy.H1: font-serif text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-bold
hierarchy.H2: font-serif text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.H3: font-sans text-xl md:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#111111]
hierarchy.Overline: font-sans text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-[#C5A059]

rules: Never center align body text. Left-align for editorial feel.
Use extremely tight tracking on massive headings.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. The negative space gives it the 'premium' feel.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A). Use 12-column grid. gap-8 or gap-12. Do not fill columns equally.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px). High-end legal design demands sharp, crisp edges, not playful bubbles.

header.style: Crystal Glassmorphism. fixed w-full top-0 z-50 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5
header.layout: Flex space-between items-center h-20. Left: 'BW.' or 'Belinda Wakasa' in font-serif font-bold text-2xl. Right: Desktop shows links + 'Contact Us' button in gold. Mobile uses hamburger.

hero.layout: Asymmetric split. min-h-screen pt-32. Grid 12 cols. Left side (col-span-12 lg:col-span-7) for typography. Right side (col-span-12 lg:col-span-5) for 'hero_justice_scales' image.
hero.visuals: Massive H1 'Advocating for Truth & Corporate Excellence'. An overline 'BELINDA WAKASA, ADVOCATE OF THE HIGH COURT OF KENYA'.
hero.cta: Sharp button. bg-[#111111] text-white hover:bg-[#C5A059] px-8 py-4 transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none inline-flex items-center gap-2.

about.layout: Grid split layout. Left: Large image 'about_gavel' taking up full height. Right: Typography and signature.
about.content: Professional profile, highlighting jurisdiction in Nairobi, Kenya. Focus on minimalist typography, large quotes.

practice_areas_bento.cards: border border-[#EAEAEA] bg-white p-8 md:p-12 hover:border-[#C5A059] transition-colors relative overflow-hidden group rounded-none.
practice_areas_bento.content: Areas: Commercial Law, Litigation, Conveyancing, Corporate Advisory.
practice_areas_bento.integration: Use 'practice_corporate' image as a subtle background or embedded visual in the largest bento box (Commercial Law).

faq.customization: Strip all default Shadcn borders. Use ONLY a 1px border-b border-[#EAEAEA] per item. Title font-serif text-xl. Content font-sans text-[#555555].

contact.form_style: Brutalist editorial form. NO enclosing boxes on inputs. Use border-b border-[#111111] ONLY for inputs. bg-transparent focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none.
contact.integration: Use an HTML form that triggers a mailto:wakasabelinda@gmail.com link on submit (no backend). Include click-to-call link for 0758 913 512.
contact.visuals: Use 'contact_abstract' subtly in the side panel.

whatsapp_floating.style: bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-2xl hover:scale-110 transition-transform flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer
whatsapp_floating.icon: Use WhatsApp icon or message circle. Must link to a standard WhatsApp API wa.me link for Kenya (+254758913512).

footer.content: Contact details (0758 913 512, wakasabelinda@gmail.com, Nairobi). Golden accents for links. Use 'nairobi_skyline' in a low-opacity blend mode on one side.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Smooth scrolling is MANDATORY. Main agent MUST install and implement `lenis` (@studio-freight/lenis).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and links must have distinct color shifts. Image containers should have a subtle scale-up on inner image on hover (e.g., group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-700).
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up for bento grid cards via Framer Motion.

hero_visual.description: Abstract minimalist white marble scales of justice with matte gold. Use on the right side of the Hero section.

about_visual.description: Close up macro of a legal gavel. Use in the About Section as the primary visual anchor.

practice_corporate_visual.description: Abstract floating gold and black planes. Embed inside the Commercial Law bento box to break up text.

contact_abstract_visual.description: Abstract flowing matte gold lines. Use in the Contact section to add elegance.

nairobi_skyline.description: Nairobi skyline. Use in the footer or contact section background to ground the location context (blend mode overlay).

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based names.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use a generic Vercel/Stripe SaaS design. This is a high-end luxury legal portfolio. Use the Swiss Brutalist/Editorial rules defined here.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or 'Open Sans' for Headings. You MUST import and use 'Playfair Display' for all headings and 'Manrope' for body text in index.css and tailwind config.
Do NOT center-align everything. Embrace asymmetry and left-aligned editorial text.
Do NOT use heavy box-shadows. Use sharp 1px borders (#EAEAEA) and high contrast text.
Ensure the hero overlay is non-existent or maximum bg-white/20. The abstract visuals provided have clean white backgrounds and should blend beautifully with #FDFDFD.
Implement pure HTML+Tailwind for layouts. ONLY use Shadcn for the FAQ Accordion or form elements, but heavily customize them to remove standard borders and radii.
Include the specified media URLs directly in the src tags of images. Do NOT use placeholder services.
Add 'data-testid' to every single interactive element to satisfy QA rules.
Ensure contact form uses simple mailto link as requested, no backend integrations.
Do NOT add a blog section as explicitly restricted by user.
